search_log: Listed every Alnylam (CIK 0001178670) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older pages). Earnings releases were taken from every 8-K/8-K/A whose items include 2.02, 9.01 or 7.01 filed 2018-07 to 2026-11 (2024-2025 releases carry only Item 9.01, so an Item 2.02-only filter would have missed them); each filing's index.json was read and every non-primary .htm exhibit fetched.

Each release's HTML table rows were parsed; the product row was taken from the net product revenues table (first table whose first cell is the product name), current three-month column first. The quarter is the one the release reports (filed in the month after quarter end).

2025Q1: the 8-K release filed 2025-05-01 prints only 'Total TTR' and 'Total Rare' net product revenues, so the quarter is read from the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2025 (product heading followed by regional lines and a 'Total' line).
Units: every table used is headed '(In thousands ...)' and was checked programmatically; values converted to USD millions.

Full-year checks (quarters sum to the printed full year): 2020: 5.274 + 10.998 + 16.69 + 22.144 = 55.106 vs 55.106 (full-year column of the Q4 quote); 2021: 24.673 + 30.63 + 31.833 + 40.679 = 127.815 vs 127.815 (full-year column of the Q4 quote); 2022: 35.277 + 45.15 + 45.659 + 47.058 = 173.144 vs 173.144 (full-year column of the Q4 quote); 2023: 47.906 + 57.899 + 54.148 + 59.298 = 219.251 vs 219.251 (full-year column of the Q4 quote); 2024: 58.056 + 62.127 + 71.043 + 64.645 = 255.871 vs 255.871 (full-year column of the Q4 quote); 2025: 66.968 + 80.849 + 73.874 + 86.796 = 308.487 vs 308.487 (twelve-months table of the 2025Q4 release filed 2026-02-12)
